name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — EDGAR APIs
access: HTTPS GET to data.sec.gov / www.sec.gov; no API key; server-side only (no CORS)

rate_limit.source: https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data ('Current max request rate: 10 requests/second'; SEC may limit further)

failure_behavior: 429/403 or connection errors: back off exponentially, stop the run after bounded retries, record the run as FAILED; never exceed the declared rate; data already stored remains with its availability times.

datasets.description: Filing history per registrant (forms, accession numbers, filing dates, acceptance timestamps, former names)
datasets.history_depth: recent filings in the main file; older filings in additional submissions files
datasets.availability_rule: a filing is available at its EDGAR acceptance timestamp (acceptanceDateTime), never earlier
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/privacy (public information; cite SEC; do not use SEC seal or logos); redistribution not asserted here

datasets.description: XBRL financial data per company, every reported value with accession number, form, fiscal period and filing date
datasets.history_depth: as far back as XBRL filings exist for the registrant
datasets.availability_rule: each reported value is available at the acceptance timestamp of its accession (joined from sec.submissions); if unknown, at 23:59:59 America/New_York on the 'filed' date (conservative)

datasets.description: EDGAR Latest Filings Atom feed: one entry per filing and entity role, with form type, filer name and CIK, role (Filer, Subject, Reporting, ...), accession number, acceptance time (<updated>), size and, for 8-K, the item lines; link to the filing index
datasets.coverage: all EDGAR filers and forms disseminated recently (most recent first, paged by start/count)
datasets.history_depth: recent window only; the daily index is the reconciliation source (not implemented here)
datasets.update_frequency: as EDGAR disseminates filings (cadence not documented; polled every 60 s by default)
datasets.availability_rule: a filing is usable from the time this system first saw it in the feed (first_seen); the feed's acceptance time is kept as the event time and is never used as availability
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information ('Information presented on sec.gov is considered public information and may be copied or further distributed ... without the SEC's permission'); fair access at https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data ('Current max request rate: 10 requests/second'; declared User-Agent required; no unclassified bots)

datasets.description: SEC press releases RSS (headline, link, publication time and the feed's description)
datasets.update_frequency: as releases are published (polled every 15 min)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's pubDate is kept as the publication time
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information (public information; cite the SEC). The URL is the one linked from https://www.sec.gov/about/rss-feeds and https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases, it answered HTTP 404 to a declared-User-Agent client and to a second fetcher early on 2026-10-23 and HTTP 200 (25 items) to the poller later that day; a failed poll is recorded as FAILED and shown with its error, never as an empty feed

datasets.description: SEC litigation releases RSS (headline, link, publication time, release number)
datasets.history_depth: the feed's recent window (25 items on 2026-10-23)
datasets.update_frequency: as releases are published (polled every 15 min)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's pubDate is kept as the publication time
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information (public information; cite the SEC); feed listed at https://www.sec.gov/about/rss-feeds

datasets.description: Insider ownership reports (Forms 3, 4, 5 and amendments): the XML ownership document of each filing listed in the issuer's submissions (issuer, reporting owner and relationship, non-derivative and derivative transactions and holdings with codes, shares, prices and post-transaction holdings, footnotes)
datasets.endpoint: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<issuer CIK>/<accession without dashes>/<primaryDocument without its xsl* rendering folder>
datasets.coverage: Section 16 filings in the issuer's main submissions file (XML ownership documents; issuerCik must equal the issuer)
datasets.history_depth: the ingestion lookback (default 365 days of filings) within the main submissions file
datasets.update_frequency: as filings are disseminated; fetched when the owner runs the ingestion
datasets.availability_rule: each transaction is available at the EDGAR acceptance time of its accession (submissions acceptanceDateTime), never earlier
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information ('Information presented on sec.gov is considered public information and may be copied or further distributed by users of the web site without the SEC's permission'); fair access https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data ('Current max request rate: 10 requests/second', declared User-Agent); data set description https://www.sec.gov/data-research/sec-markets-data/insider-transactions-data-sets

datasets.description: Beneficial ownership reports (Schedules 13D and 13G and amendments) on the issuer: structured XML cover pages (reporting persons, aggregate amount, percent of class, issuer CUSIP, event date) since the December 2024 structured-data rule; earlier free-text filings are listed with their links only
datasets.endpoint: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<issuer CIK>/<accession without dashes>/<primaryDocument without its xsl* rendering folder>
datasets.coverage: Schedule 13D/13G filings in the issuer's main submissions file where the issuer is the subject company (issuerCik must equal the issuer)
datasets.history_depth: the ingestion lookback (default 1,095 days) within the main submissions file
datasets.update_frequency: as filings are disseminated; fetched when the owner runs the ingestion
datasets.availability_rule: available at the EDGAR acceptance time of the accession (submissions acceptanceDateTime)
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information (public information; cite the SEC); fair access https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data

datasets.description: Form 13F data sets: the XML information tables of 13F-HR filings flattened by the SEC into quarterly ZIP files (SUBMISSION, COVERPAGE, INFOTABLE, ...). Rows for the ingested issuers' CUSIPs are aggregated per manager and report period (shares, market value)
datasets.endpoint: https://www.sec.gov/data-research/sec-markets-data/form-13f-data-sets (one ZIP per three-month filing window, e.g. .../form-13f-data-sets/01jun2026-31aug2026_form13f.zip)
datasets.coverage: 13F-HR and 13F-HR/A filings disseminated in the window of each data set (any report period; late filers appear in later windows)
datasets.history_depth: data sets from 2013 Q3; the ingestion takes the windows the owner selects (default the two latest)
datasets.update_frequency: a new ZIP per three-month filing window
datasets.availability_rule: a holding is available at 23:59:59 America/New_York on the FILING_DATE of its accession (the data set carries a date only, so this is conservative); the report period is kept as the period
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/data-research/sec-markets-data/form-13f-data-sets ('extracted from the eXtensible Markup Language (XML) based portion of Form 13F submissions ... presented without change from the as-filed submissions'); public information per https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information

datasets.description: Announced results dates: the primary document of the issuer's recent 8-K filings with Item 7.01 or 8.01, searched for a sentence that schedules a results release or call on a stated date
datasets.coverage: 8-K filings with Item 7.01 or 8.01 in the issuer's main submissions file within the lookback (default 200 days, at most 20 documents per issuer)
datasets.update_frequency: fetched when the owner runs the ingestion
datasets.availability_rule: an announced date is available at the acceptance time of the 8-K that states it
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/about/privacy-information (public information; cite the SEC); fair access https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data
